name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE

changelog: Performance improvements to make creating and browsing faster.

summary: The TikTok APK is the Android installer for TikTok, the short-video app for watching and creating videos, going live and shopping. Google Play updated it on November 24, 2026, and the version varies by device. It's free with ads, and TikTok requires users to be at least 13.
metaDescription: TikTok APK download for Android: get the official TikTok from Google Play, with install steps, safety settings for teens and fixes when it's not working.

faq.q: Where can I download the TikTok APK safely?
faq.a: Install TikTok from Google Play, published by TikTok Pte. Ltd. TikTok doesn't publish an APK on other sites, and copies offering extra features aren't official and can steal your account.

TikTok's minimum age is 13. Accounts for under-16s are private by default, can't send direct messages, and have a 60-minute daily screen-time reminder. Parents can link accounts with Family Pairing to manage settings.

faq.q: Why is TikTok not working today?
faq.a: Common causes are a weak connection, an outdated app, a full cache, or a TikTok outage. Update the app, clear its cache in Settings → Storage, and check whether others are reporting problems.

faq.q: Can I watch TikTok without the app?
faq.a: Yes. You can watch many TikTok videos at tiktok.com in a browser, though some features such as posting and messages work best in the app.
